If `pResource` is of incorrect type or is already registered then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` cannot be registered then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedArray.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedArray(cudaArray * * ppArray, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int subResource)
cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedArray.doc:
Gets an array through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*ppArray` an array through which the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource` which corresponds to `subResource` may be accessed. The value set in `ppArray` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D10RegisterFlagsArray](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1gga76be8c7eba1b3e3c54c6c9b6b65510deaa94840c0f64372c6a5c426e527210ff8), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

For usage requirements of the `subResource` parameter, see [cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1ga45bdf8d41c3df33aa08acaa6bd3b9d84).

cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPitch.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPitch(size_t * pPitch, size_t * pPitchSlice, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int subResource)
cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPitch.doc:
Gets the pitch of a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pPitch` and `*pPitchSlice` the pitch and Z-slice pitch of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `subResource`. The values set in `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

The pitch and Z-slice pitch values may be used to compute the location of a sample on a surface as follows.

For a 2D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

For a 3D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y**, **z** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**z\*** **slicePitch** + **y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

Both parameters `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` are optional and may be set to NULL.

If `pResource` is not of type ::ID3D10Texture1D, ::ID3D10Texture2D, or ::ID3D10Texture3D, or if `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D10RegisterFlagsNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1gga76be8c7eba1b3e3c54c6c9b6b65510dea95fc2f4b886104a90e755c421cef6e89), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

For usage requirements of the `subResource` parameter see [cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1ga45bdf8d41c3df33aa08acaa6bd3b9d84).

cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer(void * * pPointer, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int subResource)
cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer.doc:
Gets a pointer through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pPointer` the base pointer of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource` which corresponds to `subResource`. The value set in `pPointer` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ggacdebbc14eb83032da31bd75503cddfeaa10cd58f205c593368626b4ec54a54744), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

If `pResource` is of type ::ID3D10Buffer then `subResource` must be 0. If `pResource` is of any other type, then the value of `subResource` must come from the subresource calculation in ::D3D10CalcSubResource().

cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedSize.doc:

If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D10RegisterFlagsNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1gga76be8c7eba1b3e3c54c6c9b6b65510dea95fc2f4b886104a90e755c421cef6e89), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. cudaD3D10ResourceGetSurfaceDimensions.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D10ResourceGetSurfaceDimensions(size_t * pWidth, size_t * pHeight, size_t * pDepth, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int subResource)
cudaD3D10ResourceGetSurfaceDimensions.doc:
Gets the dimensions of a registered Direct3D surface.

Returns in `*pWidth`, `*pHeight`, and `*pDepth` the dimensions of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource` which corresponds to `subResource`.

Since anti-aliased surfaces may have multiple samples per pixel, it is possible that the dimensions of a resource will be an integer factor larger than the dimensions reported by the Direct3D runtime.

The parameters `pWidth`, `pHeight`, and `pDepth` are optional. For 2D surfaces, the value returned in `*pDepth` will be 0.

If `pResource` is not of type ::ID3D10Texture1D, ::ID3D10Texture2D, or ::ID3D10Texture3D, or if `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then ::cudaErrorInvalidHandle is returned.

For usage requirements of `subResource` parameters see [cudaD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1ga45bdf8d41c3df33aa08acaa6bd3b9d84).

cudaD3D10ResourceSetMapFlags.doc:
Set usage flags for mapping a Direct3D resource.

Set usage flags for mapping the Direct3D resource `pResource`.

Changes to flags will take effect the next time `pResource` is mapped. The `flags` argument may be any of the following:

If `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA then ::cudaErrorInvalidHandle is returned. If `pResource` is presently mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

pResource.doc: Registered resource to set flags for.

cudaD3D10SetDirect3DDevice.doc:
Sets the Direct3D 10 device to use for interoperability with a CUDA device.

This function will immediately initialize the primary context on `device` if needed.

pD3D10Device.doc: Direct3D device to use for interoperability.

device.doc: The CUDA device to use. This device must be among the devices returned when querying [cudaD3D10DeviceListAll](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10.html#group__cudart__d3d10_1gga1e9ffdd1c631cab046c7d7b64e187f78ae91df6bb0bf994be807d0acec5694f30) from [cudaD3D10GetDevices](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10.html#group__cudart__d3d10_1ga70ccbdf2ed995cb7182eb97c6780996d), may be set to -1 to automatically select an appropriate CUDA device.

cudaD3D10UnmapResources.doc:
Unmaps Direct3D resources.

Unmaps the `count` Direct3D resource in `ppResources`.

This function provides the synchronization guarantee that any CUDA kernels issued before [cudaD3D10UnmapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1ga5c7ede2f5a346bf0258f3f70061494de) will complete before any Direct3D calls issued after [cudaD3D10UnmapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d10__deprecated_1ga5c7ede2f5a346bf0258f3f70061494de) begin.

If any of `ppResources` have not been registered for use with CUDA or if `ppResources` contains any duplicate entries, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If any of `ppResources` are not presently mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

count.doc: Number of resources to unmap for CUDA.

cudaD3D10UnregisterResource.doc:
Unregisters a Direct3D resource.

Unregisters the Direct3D resource `resource` so it is not accessible by CUDA unless registered again.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned.

cudaD3D11DeviceList.doc: CUDA devices corresponding to a D3D11 device.

cudaD3D11DeviceListAll.doc: The CUDA devices for all GPUs used by a D3D11 device.

cudaD3D11DeviceListCurrentFrame.doc: The CUDA devices for the GPUs used by a D3D11 device in its currently rendering frame.

cudaD3D11DeviceListNextFrame.doc: The CUDA devices for the GPUs to be used by a D3D11 device in the next frame.

cudaD3D11GetDevice.doc:
Gets the device number for an adapter.

Returns in `*device` the CUDA-compatible device corresponding to the adapter `pAdapter` obtained from ::IDXGIFactory::EnumAdapters. This call will succeed only if a device on adapter `pAdapter` is CUDA-compatible.

device.doc: Returns the device corresponding to pAdapter.

pAdapter.doc: D3D11 adapter to get device for.

cudaD3D11GetDevices.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D11GetDevices(unsigned int * pCudaDeviceCount, int * pCudaDevices, unsigned int cudaDeviceCount, ID3D11Device * pD3D11Device, enum cudaD3D11DeviceList deviceList)
cudaD3D11GetDevices.doc:
Gets the CUDA devices corresponding to a Direct3D 11 device.

Returns in `*pCudaDeviceCount` the number of CUDA-compatible devices corresponding to the Direct3D 11 device `pD3D11Device`. Also returns in `*pCudaDevices` at most `cudaDeviceCount` of the CUDA-compatible devices corresponding to the Direct3D 11 device `pD3D11Device`.

If any of the GPUs being used to render `pDevice` are not CUDA capable then the call will return [cudaErrorNoDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae942e4cbbd2bef6e92e293253f055613).

pCudaDeviceCount.doc: Returned number of CUDA devices corresponding to `pD3D11Device`.

cudaDeviceCount.doc: The size of the output device array `pCudaDevices`.

pD3D11Device.doc: Direct3D 11 device to query for CUDA devices.

deviceList.doc: The set of devices to return. This set may be [cudaD3D11DeviceListAll](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D11.html#group__cudart__d3d11_1ggad1c6ace5a5bb075401c4f74446f73913a309be5288ec4b25ade1f828c5d6c4088) for all devices, [cudaD3D11DeviceListCurrentFrame](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D11.html#group__cudart__d3d11_1ggad1c6ace5a5bb075401c4f74446f73913ab7de5482aa2662ebf4ad8b6ea8eec48f) for the devices used to render the current frame (in SLI), or [cudaD3D11DeviceListNextFrame](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D11.html#group__cudart__d3d11_1ggad1c6ace5a5bb075401c4f74446f73913a357875ff93e3f5707b76bec1020e9952) for the devices used to render the next frame (in SLI).

cudaGraphicsD3D11RegisterResource.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaGraphicsD3D11RegisterResource(struct cudaGraphicsResource * * resource, ID3D11Resource * pD3DResource, unsigned int flags)
cudaGraphicsD3D11RegisterResource.doc:
Register a Direct3D 11 resource for access by CUDA.

Registers the Direct3D 11 resource `pD3DResource` for access by CUDA.

If this call is successful, then the application will be able to map and unmap this resource until it is unregistered through [cudaGraphicsUnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__INTEROP.html#group__cudart__interop_1gac65d1f2900086747de1e57301d709940). Also on success, this call will increase the internal reference count on `pD3DResource`. This reference count will be decremented when this resource is unregistered through [cudaGraphicsUnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__INTEROP.html#group__cudart__interop_1gac65d1f2900086747de1e57301d709940).

This call potentially has a high-overhead and should not be called every frame in interactive applications.

The type of `pD3DResource` must be one of the following.

The `flags` argument may be used to specify additional parameters at register time. The valid values for this parameter are

If `pD3DResource` is of incorrect type or is already registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. pD3D9Device.doc: Direct3D 9 device to query for CUDA devices.

deviceList.doc: The set of devices to return. This set may be [cudaD3D9DeviceListAll](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9.html#group__cudart__d3d9_1gga93e3d8aabc986f1799a2754135e31379ad60701634fd33febe258c9192ce49a89) for all devices, [cudaD3D9DeviceListCurrentFrame](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9.html#group__cudart__d3d9_1gga93e3d8aabc986f1799a2754135e31379adc0aed5e3d2cfc9f495054d1291747e8) for the devices used to render the current frame (in SLI), or [cudaD3D9DeviceListNextFrame](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9.html#group__cudart__d3d9_1gga93e3d8aabc986f1799a2754135e31379ae79744aff1440d3cfecb0cf225bd646f) for the devices used to render the next frame (in SLI).

cudaD3D9GetDirect3DDevice.doc:
Gets the Direct3D device against which the current CUDA context was created.

Returns in `*ppD3D9Device` the Direct3D device against which this CUDA context was created in [cudaD3D9SetDirect3DDevice()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9.html#group__cudart__d3d9_1ga0733a6f0bdc8aca6c6812da66c6d814a).

cudaD3D9SetDirect3DDevice.doc:
Sets the Direct3D 9 device to use for interoperability with a CUDA device.

Records `pD3D9Device` as the Direct3D 9 device to use for Direct3D 9 interoperability with the CUDA device `device` and sets `device` as the current device for the calling host thread.

This function will immediately initialize the primary context on `device` if needed.

If `device` has already been initialized then this call will fail with the error [cudaErrorSetOnActiveProcess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038aa906ddf08d574274bf7334adb1497550). In this case it is necessary to reset `device` using [cudaDeviceReset()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gaef69dd5c6d0206c2b8d099abac61f217) before Direct3D 9 interoperability on `device` may be enabled.

Successfully initializing CUDA interoperability with `pD3D9Device` will increase the internal reference count on `pD3D9Device`. This reference count will be decremented when `device` is reset using [cudaDeviceReset()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gaef69dd5c6d0206c2b8d099abac61f217).

Note that this function is never required for correct functionality. Use of this function will result in accelerated interoperability only when the operating system is Windows Vista or Windows 7, and the device `pD3DDdevice` is not an IDirect3DDevice9Ex. In all other cirumstances, this function is not necessary.

pD3D9Device.doc: Direct3D device to use for this thread.

device.doc: The CUDA device to use. This device must be among the devices returned when querying [cudaD3D9DeviceListAll](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9.html#group__cudart__d3d9_1gga93e3d8aabc986f1799a2754135e31379ad60701634fd33febe258c9192ce49a89) from [cudaD3D9GetDevices](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9.html#group__cudart__d3d9_1ga113d44c4c588818e27de685a58412736), may be set to -1 to automatically select an appropriate CUDA device.

cudaGraphicsD3D9RegisterResource.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaGraphicsD3D9RegisterResource(struct cudaGraphicsResource * * resource, IDirect3DResource9 * pD3DResource, unsigned int flags)
cudaGraphicsD3D9RegisterResource.doc:
Register a Direct3D 9 resource for access by CUDA.

Registers the Direct3D 9 resource `pD3DResource` for access by CUDA.

If this call is successful then the application will be able to map and unmap this resource until it is unregistered through [cudaGraphicsUnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__INTEROP.html#group__cudart__interop_1gac65d1f2900086747de1e57301d709940). Also on success, this call will increase the internal reference count on `pD3DResource`. This reference count will be decremented when this resource is unregistered through [cudaGraphicsUnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__INTEROP.html#group__cudart__interop_1gac65d1f2900086747de1e57301d709940).

This call potentially has a high-overhead and should not be called every frame in interactive applications.

The type of `pD3DResource` must be one of the following.

The `flags` argument may be used to specify additional parameters at register time. The valid values for this parameter are

If `pD3DResource` is of incorrect type or is already registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pD3DResource` cannot be registered, then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

cudaD3D9MapFlagsNone.doc: Default; Assume resource can be read/written.

cudaD3D9MapFlagsReadOnly.doc: CUDA kernels will not write to this resource.

cudaD3D9MapFlagsWriteDiscard.doc: CUDA kernels will only write to and will not read from this resource.

cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsNone.doc: Default; Resource can be accessed througa void\*.

cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsArray.doc: Resource can be accessed through a CUarray\*.

cudaD3D9MapResources.doc:
Map Direct3D resources for access by CUDA.

Maps the `count` Direct3D resources in `ppResources` for access by CUDA.

The resources in `ppResources` may be accessed in CUDA kernels until they are unmapped. Direct3D should not access any resources while they are mapped by CUDA. If an application does so, the results are undefined.

This function provides the synchronization guarantee that any Direct3D calls issued before [cudaD3D9MapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ga693b8fef0e3161e63b17f1fa633371a9) will complete before any CUDA kernels issued after [cudaD3D9MapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ga693b8fef0e3161e63b17f1fa633371a9) begin.

If any of `ppResources` have not been registered for use with CUDA or if `ppResources` contains any duplicate entries then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If any of `ppResources` are presently mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

count.doc: Number of resources to map for CUDA.

cudaD3D9RegisterResource.doc:
Registers a Direct3D resource for access by CUDA.

Registers the Direct3D resource `pResource` for access by CUDA.

If this call is successful, then the application will be able to map and unmap this resource until it is unregistered through [cudaD3D9UnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1gac26c53ea7f8af2ffe4b23b8e479b5b93). Also on success, this call will increase the internal reference count on `pResource`. This reference count will be decremented when this resource is unregistered through [cudaD3D9UnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1gac26c53ea7f8af2ffe4b23b8e479b5b93).

This call potentially has a high-overhead and should not be called every frame in interactive applications.

The type of `pResource` must be one of the following.

The `flags` argument specifies the mechanism through which CUDA will access the Direct3D resource. The following value is allowed:

Not all Direct3D resources of the above types may be used for interoperability with CUDA. The following are some limitations:

If Direct3D interoperability is not initialized on this context, then [cudaErrorInvalidDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a938c6e8b96ecde62e3ab5137156f739a) is returned. If `pResource` is of incorrect type (e.g, is a non-stand-alone ::IDirect3DSurface9) or is already registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` cannot be registered then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedArray.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedArray(cudaArray * * ppArray, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int face, unsigned int level)
cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedArray.doc:
Get an array through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pArray` an array through which the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `face` and `level` may be accessed. The value set in `pArray` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsArray](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ggacdebbc14eb83032da31bd75503cddfeaaa4c940a582866d5cf40ede9dbfa1f5e5), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped, then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

For usage requirements of `face` and `level` parameters, see [cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ga1980005bc217f83df499271e73b020df).

cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPitch.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPitch(size_t * pPitch, size_t * pPitchSlice, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int face, unsigned int level)
cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPitch.doc:
Get the pitch of a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pPitch` and `*pPitchSlice` the pitch and Z-slice pitch of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `face` and `level`. The values set in `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

The pitch and Z-slice pitch values may be used to compute the location of a sample on a surface as follows.

For a 2D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

For a 3D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y**, **z** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**z\*** **slicePitch** + **y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

Both parameters `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` are optional and may be set to NULL.

If `pResource` is not of type ::IDirect3DBaseTexture9 or one of its sub-types or if `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ggacdebbc14eb83032da31bd75503cddfeaa10cd58f205c593368626b4ec54a54744), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

For usage requirements of `face` and `level` parameters, see [cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ga1980005bc217f83df499271e73b020df).

cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer(void * * pPointer, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int face, unsigned int level)
cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer.doc:
Get a pointer through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pPointer` the base pointer of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `face` and `level`. The value set in `pPointer` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ggacdebbc14eb83032da31bd75503cddfeaa10cd58f205c593368626b4ec54a54744), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped, then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

If `pResource` is of type ::IDirect3DCubeTexture9, then `face` must one of the values enumerated by type ::D3DCUBEMAP_FACES. For all other types, `face` must be 0. If `face` is invalid, then [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c) is returned.

If `pResource` is of type ::IDirect3DBaseTexture9, then `level` must correspond to a valid mipmap level. Only mipmap level 0 is supported for now. For all other types `level` must be 0. If `level` is invalid, then [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c) is returned.

cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedSize.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedSize(size_t * pSize, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int face, unsigned int level)
cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedSize.doc:
Get the size of a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pSize` the size of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `face` and `level`. The value set in `pSize` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [cudaD3D9RegisterFlagsNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ggacdebbc14eb83032da31bd75503cddfeaa10cd58f205c593368626b4ec54a54744), then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

For usage requirements of `face` and `level` parameters, see [cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ga1980005bc217f83df499271e73b020df).

cudaD3D9ResourceGetSurfaceDimensions.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaD3D9ResourceGetSurfaceDimensions(size_t * pWidth, size_t * pHeight, size_t * pDepth, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int face, unsigned int level)
cudaD3D9ResourceGetSurfaceDimensions.doc:
Get the dimensions of a registered Direct3D surface.

Returns in `*pWidth`, `*pHeight`, and `*pDepth` the dimensions of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource` which corresponds to `face` and `level`.

Since anti-aliased surfaces may have multiple samples per pixel, it is possible that the dimensions of a resource will be an integer factor larger than the dimensions reported by the Direct3D runtime.

The parameters `pWidth`, `pHeight`, and `pDepth` are optional. For 2D surfaces, the value returned in `*pDepth` will be 0.

If `pResource` is not of type ::IDirect3DBaseTexture9 or ::IDirect3DSurface9 or if `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned.

For usage requirements of `face` and `level` parameters, see [cudaD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1ga1980005bc217f83df499271e73b020df).

cudaD3D9ResourceSetMapFlags.doc:
Set usage flags for mapping a Direct3D resource.

Set flags for mapping the Direct3D resource `pResource`.

Changes to flags will take effect the next time `pResource` is mapped. The `flags` argument may be any of the following:

If `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If `pResource` is presently mapped for access by CUDA, then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

pResource.doc: Registered resource to set flags for.

cudaD3D9UnmapResources.doc:
Unmap Direct3D resources for access by CUDA.

Unmaps the `count` Direct3D resources in `ppResources`.

This function provides the synchronization guarantee that any CUDA kernels issued before [cudaD3D9UnmapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1gae90f331435ae737057add0a618bc9b4d) will complete before any Direct3D calls issued after [cudaD3D9UnmapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cudart__d3d9__deprecated_1gae90f331435ae737057add0a618bc9b4d) begin.

If any of `ppResources` have not been registered for use with CUDA or if `ppResources` contains any duplicate entries, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned. If any of `ppResources` are not presently mapped for access by CUDA then [cudaErrorUnknown](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a2e491daacef266c7b3e3c1e140a6133c) is returned.

count.doc: Number of resources to unmap for CUDA.

cudaD3D9UnregisterResource.doc:
Unregisters a Direct3D resource for access by CUDA.

Unregisters the Direct3D resource `pResource` so it is not accessible by CUDA unless registered again.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ac4673247aee4d1ab8d07871f376e0273) is returned.

cudaGetDriverEntryPoint.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaGetDriverEntryPoint(const char * symbol, void * * funcPtr, unsigned long long flags, enum cudaDriverEntryPointQueryResult * driverStatus = NULL)
cudaGetDriverEntryPoint.doc:
Returns the requested driver API function pointer.

Returns in `**funcPtr` the address of the CUDA driver function for the requested flags.

For a requested driver symbol, if the CUDA version in which the driver symbol was introduced is less than or equal to the CUDA runtime version, the API will return the function pointer to the corresponding versioned driver function.

The pointer returned by the API should be cast to a function pointer matching the requested driver function’s definition in the API header file. The function pointer typedef can be picked up from the corresponding typedefs header file. For example, cudaTypedefs.h consists of function pointer typedefs for driver APIs defined in cuda.h.

The API will return [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) and set the returned `funcPtr` if the requested driver function is valid and supported on the platform.

The API will return [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) and set the returned `funcPtr` to NULL if the requested driver function is not supported on the platform, no ABI compatible driver function exists for the CUDA runtime version or if the driver symbol is invalid.

It will also set the optional `driverStatus` to one of the values in [cudaDriverEntryPointQueryResult](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaeb22957eedf779d624069585c25f1d1f) with the following meanings:

The requested flags can be.

symbol.doc: The base name of the driver API function to look for. As an example, for the driver API ::cuMemAlloc_v2, `symbol` would be cuMemAlloc. Note that the API will use the CUDA runtime version to return the address to the most recent ABI compatible driver symbol, ::cuMemAlloc or ::cuMemAlloc_v2.

funcPtr.doc: Location to return the function pointer to the requested driver function.

driverStatus.doc: Optional location to store the status of finding the symbol from the driver. See [cudaDriverEntryPointQueryResult](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaeb22957eedf779d624069585c25f1d1f) for possible values.

cudaGetDriverEntryPointByVersion.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaGetDriverEntryPointByVersion(const char * symbol, void * * funcPtr, unsigned int cudaVersion, unsigned long long flags, enum cudaDriverEntryPointQueryResult * driverStatus = NULL)
cudaGetDriverEntryPointByVersion.doc:
Returns the requested driver API function pointer by CUDA version.

Returns in `**funcPtr` the address of the CUDA driver function for the requested flags and CUDA driver version.

The CUDA version is specified as (1000 \* major + 10 \* minor), so CUDA 11.2 should be specified as 11020. For a requested driver symbol, if the specified CUDA version is greater than or equal to the CUDA version in which the driver symbol was introduced, this API will return the function pointer to the corresponding versioned function. If the specified CUDA version is greater than the driver version, the API will return [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c).

The pointer returned by the API should be cast to a function pointer matching the requested driver function’s definition in the API header file. The function pointer typedef can be picked up from the corresponding typedefs header file. For example, cudaTypedefs.h consists of function pointer typedefs for driver APIs defined in cuda.h.

For the case where the CUDA version requested is greater than the CUDA Toolkit installed, there may not be an appropriate function pointer typedef in the corresponding header file and may need a custom typedef to match the driver function signature returned. This can be done by getting the typedefs from a later toolkit or creating appropriately matching custom function typedefs.

The API will return [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) and set the returned `funcPtr` if the requested driver function is valid and supported on the platform.

The API will return [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) and set the returned `funcPtr` to NULL if the requested driver function is not supported on the platform, no ABI compatible driver function exists for the requested version or if the driver symbol is invalid.

It will also set the optional `driverStatus` to one of the values in [cudaDriverEntryPointQueryResult](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaeb22957eedf779d624069585c25f1d1f) with the following meanings:

The requested flags can be.

symbol.doc: The base name of the driver API function to look for. As an example, for the driver API ::cuMemAlloc_v2, `symbol` would be cuMemAlloc.

funcPtr.doc: Location to return the function pointer to the requested driver function.

cudaVersion.doc: The CUDA version to look for the requested driver symbol.

driverStatus.doc: Optional location to store the status of finding the symbol from the driver. See [cudaDriverEntryPointQueryResult](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaeb22957eedf779d624069585c25f1d1f) for possible values.

cudaGraphicsEGLRegisterImage.doc:
Registers an EGL image.

Registers the EGLImageKHR specified by `image` for access by CUDA. A handle to the registered object is returned as `pCudaResource`. Additional Mapping/Unmapping is not required for the registered resource and [cudaGraphicsResourceGetMappedEglFrame](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EGL.html#group__cudart__egl_1gadd6215655a241c047d6d4939e242202a) can be directly called on the `pCudaResource`.

The application will be responsible for synchronizing access to shared objects. The application must ensure that any pending operation which access the objects have completed before passing control to CUDA. This may be accomplished by issuing and waiting for glFinish command on all GLcontexts (for OpenGL and likewise for other APIs). The application will be also responsible for ensuring that any pending operation on the registered CUDA resource has completed prior to executing subsequent commands in other APIs accessing the same memory objects. This can be accomplished by calling cuCtxSynchronize or cuEventSynchronize (preferably).

The surface’s intended usage is specified using `flags`, as follows:

The EGLImageKHR is an object which can be used to create EGLImage target resource. It is defined as a void pointer. typedef void\* EGLImageKHR.

cudaLogsDumpToMemory.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaLogsDumpToMemory(cudaLogIterator * iterator, char * buffer, size_t * size, unsigned int flags)
cudaLogsDumpToMemory.doc:
Dump accumulated driver logs into a buffer.

Logs generated by the driver are stored in an internal buffer and can be copied out using this API. This API dumps driver logs from `iterator` into `buffer` up to the size specified in `*size`. The driver will always null terminate the buffer but there will not be a null character between log entries, only a newline \n. The driver will then return the actual number of bytes written in `*size`, excluding the null terminator. If there are no messages to dump, `*size` will be set to 0 and the function will return ::CUDA_SUCCESS. If the provided `buffer` is not large enough to hold any messages, `*size` will be set to 0 and the function will return ::CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE.

iterator.doc: Optional auto-advancing iterator specifying the starting log to read. NULL value dumps all logs.

flags.doc: Reserved for future use, must be 0.
