Note that there are both device-wide and system-wide limitations per system configuration, as noted in the CUDA Programming Guide under the section “Peer-to-Peer Memory Access”.

Returns [cudaErrorInvalidDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a938c6e8b96ecde62e3ab5137156f739a) if [cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__PEER.html#group__cudart__peer_1ga4db0d04e44995d5c1c34be4ecc863f22) indicates that the current device cannot directly access memory from `peerDevice`.

Returns [cudaErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a0bc28e8217afa14b95f907631cb84f33) if direct access of `peerDevice` from the current device has already been enabled.

Returns [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c) if `flags` is not 0.

peerDevice.doc: Peer device to enable direct access to from the current device.

flags.doc: Reserved for future use and must be set to 0.

cudaProfilerStart.doc:
Enable profiling.

Enables profile collection by the active profiling tool for the current context. If profiling is already enabled, then [cudaProfilerStart()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__PROFILER.html#group__cudart__profiler_1gaf536d75bb382356e10e3b4e89f4a5374) has no effect.

cudaProfilerStart and cudaProfilerStop APIs are used to programmatically control the profiling granularity by allowing profiling to be done only on selective pieces of code.

cudaProfilerStop.doc:
Disable profiling.

Disables profile collection by the active profiling tool for the current context. If profiling is already disabled, then [cudaProfilerStop()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__PROFILER.html#group__cudart__profiler_1ga826922d9d1d0090d4a9a6b8b249cebb5) has no effect.

cudaProfilerStart and cudaProfilerStop APIs are used to programmatically control the profiling granularity by allowing profiling to be done only on selective pieces of code.

cudaCtxResetPersistingL2Cache.doc:
Resets all persisting lines in cache to normal status.

Resets all persisting lines in cache to normal status. Takes effect on function return.

cudaStreamAddCallback.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamAddCallback(cudaStream_t stream, cudaStreamCallback_t callback, void * userData, unsigned int flags)
cudaStreamAddCallback.doc:
Add a callback to a compute stream.

Adds a callback to be called on the host after all currently enqueued items in the stream have completed. For each cudaStreamAddCallback call, a callback will be executed exactly once. The callback will block later work in the stream until it is finished.

The callback may be passed [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) or an error code. In the event of a device error, all subsequently executed callbacks will receive an appropriate [cudaError_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf599e5b8b829ce7db0f5216928f6ecb6).

Callbacks must not make any CUDA API calls. Attempting to use CUDA APIs may result in [cudaErrorNotPermitted](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a67b6095ab719b21659a400b553963eb3). Callbacks must not perform any synchronization that may depend on outstanding device work or other callbacks that are not mandated to run earlier. Callbacks without a mandated order (in independent streams) execute in undefined order and may be serialized.

For the purposes of Unified Memory, callback execution makes a number of guarantees.

callback.doc: The function to call once preceding stream operations are complete.

userData.doc: User specified data to be passed to the callback function.

flags.doc: Reserved for future use, must be 0.

cudaStreamAttachMemAsync.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamAttachMemAsync(cudaStream_t stream, void * devPtr, size_t length = 0, unsigned int flags = 0x04)
cudaStreamAttachMemAsync.doc:
Attach memory to a stream asynchronously.

Enqueues an operation in `stream` to specify stream association of `length` bytes of memory starting from `devPtr`. This function is a stream-ordered operation, meaning that it is dependent on, and will only take effect when, previous work in stream has completed. Any previous association is automatically replaced.

`devPtr` must point to an one of the following types of memories:

For managed allocations, `length` must be either zero or the entire allocation’s size. Both indicate that the entire allocation’s stream association is being changed. Currently, it is not possible to change stream association for a portion of a managed allocation.

For pageable allocations, `length` must be non-zero.

The stream association is specified using `flags` which must be one of [cudaMemAttachGlobal](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4808e47eba73eb94622ec70a9f9b91ff), [cudaMemAttachHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4f9a428d18fdd89a99441d0dd27131c0) or [cudaMemAttachSingle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gadc191442d08fc3a9de4cf055edfd2dbe). The default value for `flags` is [cudaMemAttachSingle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gadc191442d08fc3a9de4cf055edfd2dbe) If the [cudaMemAttachGlobal](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4808e47eba73eb94622ec70a9f9b91ff) flag is specified, the memory can be accessed by any stream on any device. If the [cudaMemAttachHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4f9a428d18fdd89a99441d0dd27131c0) flag is specified, the program makes a guarantee that it won’t access the memory on the device from any stream on a device that has a zero value for the device attribute [cudaDevAttrConcurrentManagedAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga49e2f8c2c0bd6fe264f2fc970912e5cdac88178f29891f2c18fe67361cc80de09). If the [cudaMemAttachSingle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gadc191442d08fc3a9de4cf055edfd2dbe) flag is specified and `stream` is associated with a device that has a zero value for the device attribute [cudaDevAttrConcurrentManagedAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga49e2f8c2c0bd6fe264f2fc970912e5cdac88178f29891f2c18fe67361cc80de09), the program makes a guarantee that it will only access the memory on the device from `stream`. It is illegal to attach singly to the NULL stream, because the NULL stream is a virtual global stream and not a specific stream. An error will be returned in this case.

When memory is associated with a single stream, the Unified Memory system will allow CPU access to this memory region so long as all operations in `stream` have completed, regardless of whether other streams are active. In effect, this constrains exclusive ownership of the managed memory region by an active GPU to per-stream activity instead of whole-GPU activity.

Accessing memory on the device from streams that are not associated with it will produce undefined results. No error checking is performed by the Unified Memory system to ensure that kernels launched into other streams do not access this region.

It is a program’s responsibility to order calls to [cudaStreamAttachMemAsync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf0a73cb4de1c1b64348932f1addfbb01) via events, synchronization or other means to ensure legal access to memory at all times. Data visibility and coherency will be changed appropriately for all kernels which follow a stream-association change.

If `stream` is destroyed while data is associated with it, the association is removed and the association reverts to the default visibility of the allocation as specified at [cudaMallocManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1gaec54cd99121bfb36af81257463b5cb81). For **managed** variables, the default association is always [cudaMemAttachGlobal](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4808e47eba73eb94622ec70a9f9b91ff). Note that destroying a stream is an asynchronous operation, and as a result, the change to default association won’t happen until all work in the stream has completed.

flags.doc: Must be one of [cudaMemAttachGlobal](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4808e47eba73eb94622ec70a9f9b91ff), [cudaMemAttachHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4f9a428d18fdd89a99441d0dd27131c0) or [cudaMemAttachSingle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gadc191442d08fc3a9de4cf055edfd2dbe) (defaults to [cudaMemAttachSingle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gadc191442d08fc3a9de4cf055edfd2dbe)).

stream.doc: Stream in which to enqueue the attach operation.

devPtr.doc: Pointer to memory (must be a pointer to managed memory or to a valid host-accessible region of system-allocated memory).

cudaStreamBeginCapture.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamBeginCapture(cudaStream_t stream, enum cudaStreamCaptureMode mode)
cudaStreamBeginCapture.doc:
Begins graph capture on a stream.

Begin graph capture on `stream`. When a stream is in capture mode, all operations pushed into the stream will not be executed, but will instead be captured into a graph, which will be returned via [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e). Capture may not be initiated if `stream` is [cudaStreamLegacy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4e62d09dde16ba457b0a97f3a5262246). Capture must be ended on the same stream in which it was initiated, and it may only be initiated if the stream is not already in capture mode. The capture mode may be queried via [cudaStreamIsCapturing](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gae564e8434c67d716367931c4bc7db1cc). A unique id representing the capture sequence may be queried via [cudaStreamGetCaptureInfo](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga8d9312f1098c45e2ed43c949cfccf1f7).

If `mode` is not cudaStreamCaptureModeRelaxed, [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e) must be called on this stream from the same thread.

stream.doc: Stream in which to initiate capture.

mode.doc: Controls the interaction of this capture sequence with other API calls that are potentially unsafe. For more details see [cudaThreadExchangeStreamCaptureMode](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga9d0535d93a214cbf126835257b16ba85).

cudaStreamBeginCaptureToGraph.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamBeginCaptureToGraph(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraph_t graph, const cudaGraphNode_t * dependencies, const cudaGraphEdgeData * dependencyData, size_t numDependencies, enum cudaStreamCaptureMode mode)
cudaStreamBeginCaptureToGraph.doc:
Begins graph capture on a stream to an existing graph.

Begin graph capture on `stream`. When a stream is in capture mode, all operations pushed into the stream will not be executed, but will instead be captured into `graph`, which will be returned via [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e).

Capture may not be initiated if `stream` is [cudaStreamLegacy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4e62d09dde16ba457b0a97f3a5262246). Capture must be ended on the same stream in which it was initiated, and it may only be initiated if the stream is not already in capture mode. The capture mode may be queried via [cudaStreamIsCapturing](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gae564e8434c67d716367931c4bc7db1cc). A unique id representing the capture sequence may be queried via [cudaStreamGetCaptureInfo](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga8d9312f1098c45e2ed43c949cfccf1f7).

If `mode` is not cudaStreamCaptureModeRelaxed, [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e) must be called on this stream from the same thread.

stream.doc: Stream in which to initiate capture.

graph.doc: Graph to capture into.

dependencies.doc: Dependencies of the first node captured in the stream. Can be NULL if numDependencies is 0.

dependencyData.doc: Optional array of data associated with each dependency.

mode.doc: Controls the interaction of this capture sequence with other API calls that are potentially unsafe. For more details see [cudaThreadExchangeStreamCaptureMode](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga9d0535d93a214cbf126835257b16ba85).

cudaStreamBeginRecaptureToGraph.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamBeginRecaptureToGraph(cudaStream_t stream, enum cudaStreamCaptureMode mode, cudaGraph_t graph, struct cudaGraphRecaptureCallbackData * callbackData = 0)
cudaStreamBeginRecaptureToGraph.doc:
Begin graph capture on a stream to an existing graph.

Begin graph capture on `stream` to the existing `graph`. The node creation order while recapturing the graph must be identical to the original graph. The recapture will fail immediately for:

Any other node parameter mismatches during recapture can be configured to call the function provided in `callbackFunc`. The recapture will fail immediately if the callback returns anything other than cudaSuccess.

If the recapture fails for any reason, the `graph` will be in an undefined state and should be destroyed.

See cudaStreamBeginCapture for additional detail on beginning the capture.

stream.doc: Stream in which to initiate capture.

mode.doc: Controls the interaction of this capture sequence with other API calls that are potentially unsafe. For more details see [cudaThreadExchangeStreamCaptureMode](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga9d0535d93a214cbf126835257b16ba85).

graph.doc: Existing CUDA graph to be captured into.

callbackData.doc: Optional struct of callback data that will be invoked for all parameter mismatches from the original graph.

cudaStreamCopyAttributes.doc:
Copies attributes from source stream to destination stream.

Copies attributes from source stream `src` to destination stream `dst`. Both streams must have the same context.

src.doc: Source stream For attributes see cudaStreamAttrID.

cudaStreamCreate.doc:
Create an asynchronous stream.

Creates a new asynchronous stream on the context that is current to the calling host thread. If no context is current to the calling host thread, then the primary context for a device is selected, made current to the calling thread, and initialized before creating a stream on it.

cudaStreamCreateWithFlags.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(cudaStream_t * pStream, unsigned int flags)
cudaStreamCreateWithFlags.doc:
Create an asynchronous stream.

Creates a new asynchronous stream on the context that is current to the calling host thread. If no context is current to the calling host thread, then the primary context for a device is selected, made current to the calling thread, and initialized before creating a stream on it. The `flags` argument determines the behaviors of the stream. Valid values for `flags` are.

cudaStreamCreateWithPriority.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamCreateWithPriority(cudaStream_t * pStream, unsigned int flags, int priority)
cudaStreamCreateWithPriority.doc:
Create an asynchronous stream with the specified priority.

Creates a stream with the specified priority and returns a handle in `pStream`. The stream is created on the context that is current to the calling host thread. If no context is current to the calling host thread, then the primary context for a device is selected, made current to the calling thread, and initialized before creating a stream on it. This affects the scheduling priority of work in the stream. Priorities provide a hint to preferentially run work with higher priority when possible, but do not preempt already-running work or provide any other functional guarantee on execution order.

`priority` follows a convention where lower numbers represent higher priorities. ‘0’ represents default priority. The range of meaningful numerical priorities can be queried using [cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gafdb79818f7c0ee7bc585648c91770275). If the specified priority is outside the numerical range returned by [cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gafdb79818f7c0ee7bc585648c91770275), it will automatically be clamped to the lowest or the highest number in the range.

flags.doc: Flags for stream creation. See [cudaStreamCreateWithFlags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga138d3fc55d76cf3da8317a713113a515) for a list of valid flags that can be passed.

priority.doc: Priority of the stream. Lower numbers represent higher priorities. See [cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gafdb79818f7c0ee7bc585648c91770275) for more information about the meaningful stream priorities that can be passed.

cudaStreamDestroy.doc:
Destroys and cleans up an asynchronous stream.

Destroys and cleans up the asynchronous stream specified by `stream`.

In case the device is still doing work in the stream `stream` when [cudaStreamDestroy()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga920234e40db739baab4f2459e4f68282) is called, the function will return immediately and the resources associated with `stream` will be released automatically once the device has completed all work in `stream`.

cudaStreamEndCapture.doc:
Ends capture on a stream, returning the captured graph.

End capture on `stream`, returning the captured graph via `pGraph`. Capture must have been initiated on `stream` via a call to [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3). If capture was invalidated, due to a violation of the rules of stream capture, then a NULL graph will be returned.

If the `mode` argument to [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3) was not cudaStreamCaptureModeRelaxed, this call must be from the same thread as [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3).

cudaStreamGetAttribute.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamGetAttribute(cudaStream_t hStream, cudaLaunchAttributeID attr, cudaLaunchAttributeValue * value_out)
cudaStreamGetAttribute.doc:
Queries stream attribute.

Queries attribute `attr` from `hStream` and stores it in corresponding member of `value_out`.

cudaStreamGetCaptureInfo.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamGetCaptureInfo(cudaStream_t stream, enum cudaStreamCaptureStatus * captureStatus_out, unsigned long long * id_out = 0, cudaGraph_t * graph_out = 0, const cudaGraphNode_t * * dependencies_out = 0, const cudaGraphEdgeData * * edgeData_out = 0, size_t * numDependencies_out = 0)
cudaStreamGetCaptureInfo.doc:
Query a stream’s capture state.

Query stream state related to stream capture.

If called on [cudaStreamLegacy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4e62d09dde16ba457b0a97f3a5262246) (the “null stream”) while a stream not created with [cudaStreamNonBlocking](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga5dbd11a1723d9f5938a133cedbc525e3) is capturing, returns [cudaErrorStreamCaptureImplicit](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038acf775033deb76dbde57b8df7bd9244e7).

Valid data (other than capture status) is returned only if both of the following are true:

If `edgeData_out` is non-NULL then `dependencies_out` must be as well. If `dependencies_out` is non-NULL and `edgeData_out` is NULL, but there is non-zero edge data for one or more of the current stream dependencies, the call will return [cudaErrorLossyQuery](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ad484d9d8e8f269cf93d4c111b646f908).

captureStatus_out.doc: Location to return the capture status of the stream; required.

id_out.doc: Optional location to return an id for the capture sequence, which is unique over the lifetime of the process.

graph_out.doc: Optional location to return the graph being captured into. All operations other than destroy and node removal are permitted on the graph while the capture sequence is in progress. This API does not transfer ownership of the graph, which is transferred or destroyed at [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e). Note that the graph handle may be invalidated before end of capture for certain errors. Nodes that are or become unreachable from the original stream at [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e) due to direct actions on the graph do not trigger [cudaErrorStreamCaptureUnjoined](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ace9e4b4b58c1abf9faa1ce8b1079076d).

dependencies_out.doc: Optional location to store a pointer to an array of nodes. The next node to be captured in the stream will depend on this set of nodes, absent operations such as event wait which modify this set. The array pointer is valid until the next API call which operates on the stream or until the capture is terminated. The node handles may be copied out and are valid until they or the graph is destroyed. The driver-owned array may also be passed directly to APIs that operate on the graph (not the stream) without copying.

edgeData_out.doc: Optional location to store a pointer to an array of graph edge data. This array parallels `dependencies_out`; the next node to be added has an edge to `dependencies_out`[i] with annotation `edgeData_out`[i] for each `i`. The array pointer is valid until the next API call which operates on the stream or until the capture is terminated.

numDependencies_out.doc: Optional location to store the size of the array returned in dependencies_out.

cudaStreamGetDevice.doc:
Query the device of a stream.

Returns in `*device` the device of the stream.

hStream.doc: Handle to the stream to be queried.

device.doc: Returns the device to which the stream belongs.

cudaStreamGetFlags.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamGetFlags(cudaStream_t hStream, unsigned int * flags)
cudaStreamGetFlags.doc:
Query the flags of a stream.

Query the flags of a stream. The flags are returned in `flags`. See [cudaStreamCreateWithFlags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga138d3fc55d76cf3da8317a713113a515) for a list of valid flags.

hStream.doc: Handle to the stream to be queried.

flags.doc: Pointer to an unsigned integer in which the stream’s flags are returned.

cudaStreamGetId.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamGetId(cudaStream_t hStream, unsigned long long * streamId)
cudaStreamGetId.doc:
Query the Id of a stream.

Query the Id of a stream. The Id is returned in `streamId`. The Id is unique for the life of the program.

The stream handle `hStream` can refer to any of the following.

hStream.doc: Handle to the stream to be queried.

streamId.doc: Pointer to an unsigned long long in which the stream Id is returned.

cudaStreamGetPriority.doc:
Query the priority of a stream.

Query the priority of a stream. The priority is returned in in `priority`. Note that if the stream was created with a priority outside the meaningful numerical range returned by [cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gafdb79818f7c0ee7bc585648c91770275), this function returns the clamped priority. See [cudaStreamCreateWithPriority](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gae2be9e9858849bf62ba4a8b66d1c3540) for details about priority clamping.

hStream.doc: Handle to the stream to be queried.

priority.doc: Pointer to a signed integer in which the stream’s priority is returned.

cudaStreamIsCapturing.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamIsCapturing(cudaStream_t stream, enum cudaStreamCaptureStatus * pCaptureStatus)
cudaStreamIsCapturing.doc:
Returns a stream’s capture status.

Return the capture status of `stream` via `pCaptureStatus`. After a successful call, `*pCaptureStatus` will contain one of the following:

Note that, if this is called on [cudaStreamLegacy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga4e62d09dde16ba457b0a97f3a5262246) (the “null stream”) while a blocking stream on the same device is capturing, it will return [cudaErrorStreamCaptureImplicit](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038acf775033deb76dbde57b8df7bd9244e7) and `*pCaptureStatus` is unspecified after the call. The blocking stream capture is not invalidated.

When a blocking stream is capturing, the legacy stream is in an unusable state until the blocking stream capture is terminated. The legacy stream is not supported for stream capture, but attempted use would have an implicit dependency on the capturing stream(s).

cudaStreamQuery.doc:
Queries an asynchronous stream for completion status.

Returns [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) if all operations in `stream` have completed, or [cudaErrorNotReady](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a285d0c852ab65b8925505e1065563f6d) if not.

For the purposes of Unified Memory, a return value of [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) is equivalent to having called [cudaStreamSynchronize()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga82b5784f674c17c6df64affe618bf45e).

cudaStreamSetAttribute.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamSetAttribute(cudaStream_t hStream, cudaLaunchAttributeID attr, const cudaLaunchAttributeValue * value)
cudaStreamSetAttribute.doc:
Sets stream attribute.

Sets attribute `attr` on `hStream` from corresponding attribute of `value`. The updated attribute will be applied to subsequent work submitted to the stream. It will not affect previously submitted work.

cudaStreamSynchronize.doc:
Waits for stream tasks to complete.

Blocks until `stream` has completed all operations. If the [cudaDeviceScheduleBlockingSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga057e6912c52708b6aa86e79dd83d007c) flag was set for this device, the host thread will block until the stream is finished with all of its tasks.

cudaStreamUpdateCaptureDependencies.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamUpdateCaptureDependencies(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraphNode_t * dependencies, const cudaGraphEdgeData * dependencyData, size_t numDependencies, unsigned int flags = 0)
cudaStreamUpdateCaptureDependencies.doc:
Update the set of dependencies in a capturing stream.

Modifies the dependency set of a capturing stream. The dependency set is the set of nodes that the next captured node in the stream will depend on.

Valid flags are [cudaStreamAddCaptureDependencies](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga36421316e18c4a2f66905cf41bf8ce6fa2d9c20d80bfa97109439be472c67d9c4) and [cudaStreamSetCaptureDependencies](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga36421316e18c4a2f66905cf41bf8ce6fada9c5ad0afcd24d659a48769b931563a). These control whether the set passed to the API is added to the existing set or replaces it. A flags value of 0 defaults to [cudaStreamAddCaptureDependencies](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga36421316e18c4a2f66905cf41bf8ce6fa2d9c20d80bfa97109439be472c67d9c4).

Nodes that are removed from the dependency set via this API do not result in [cudaErrorStreamCaptureUnjoined](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ace9e4b4b58c1abf9faa1ce8b1079076d) if they are unreachable from the stream at [cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e).

Returns [cudaErrorIllegalState](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a0604022302a2ed15d31bc33546b2e963) if the stream is not capturing.

dependencies.doc: The set of dependencies to add.

dependencyData.doc: Optional array of data associated with each dependency.

numDependencies.doc: The size of the dependencies array.

cudaStreamWaitEvent.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaStreamWaitEvent(cudaStream_t stream, cudaEvent_t event, unsigned int flags = 0)
cudaStreamWaitEvent.doc:
Make a compute stream wait on an event.

Makes all future work submitted to `stream` wait for all work captured in `event`. See [cudaEventRecord()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EVENT.html#group__cudart__event_1gac9bd8aa1d0473f9b39460701d39a388a) for details on what is captured by an event. The synchronization will be performed efficiently on the device when applicable. `event` may be from a different device than `stream`.

flags include.

cudaThreadExchangeStreamCaptureMode.doc:
Swaps the stream capture interaction mode for a thread.

Sets the calling thread’s stream capture interaction mode to the value contained in `*mode`, and overwrites `*mode` with the previous mode for the thread. To facilitate deterministic behavior across function or module boundaries, callers are encouraged to use this API in a push-pop fashion:

During stream capture (see [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3)), some actions, such as a call to [cudaMalloc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1gae63c9974e34b14fd750efd91b32f405b), may be unsafe. In the case of [cudaMalloc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1gae63c9974e34b14fd750efd91b32f405b), the operation is not enqueued asynchronously to a stream, and is not observed by stream capture. Therefore, if the sequence of operations captured via [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3) depended on the allocation being replayed whenever the graph is launched, the captured graph would be invalid.

Therefore, stream capture places restrictions on API calls that can be made within or concurrently to a [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3)-[cudaStreamEndCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1gaf5a0efebc818054ceecd1e3e5e76d93e) sequence. This behavior can be controlled via this API and flags to [cudaStreamBeginCapture](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga793d7d4e474388ddfda531603dc34aa3).

A thread’s mode is one of the following.

cudaError_t(__stdcall * cudaGraphRecaptu.signature: cudaError_t(__stdcall * cudaGraphRecaptureCallback_t)(void *data, cudaGraphNode_t node, const struct cudaGraphNodeParams *originalParams, const struct cudaGraphNodeParams *recaptureParams, enum cudaGraphRecaptureStatus status)
cudaError_t(__stdcall * cudaGraphRecaptu.doc:
Callback function invoked when node parameter mismatches are detected while recapturing to an existing graph.

Parameter struct pointers are only valid within the callback.

fields.Param data: User parameter provided at beginning of recapture
fields.Param node: Graph node with the parameter mismatch
fields.Param originalParams: The original node parameters from the graph
fields.Param recaptureParams: The node parameters received during the recapture
fields.Param status: status Status code for the recapture of the node
fields.Return: Error code for the callback. Anything other than cudaSuccess will cause the recapture to fail immediately.

void(__stdcall * cudaStreamCallback_t )(.signature: void(__stdcall * cudaStreamCallback_t)(cudaStream_t stream, cudaError_t status, void *userData)

fields.Param stream: The stream as passed to [cudaStreamAddCallback](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga74aa9f4b1c2f12d994bf13876a5a2498), may be NULL.
fields.Param status: [cudaSuccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ae355f04607d824883b4a50662830d591) or any persistent error on the stream.

cudaFreeAsync.doc:
Frees memory with stream ordered semantics.

Inserts a free operation into `hStream`. The allocation must not be accessed after stream execution reaches the free. After this API returns, accessing the memory from any subsequent work launched on the GPU or querying its pointer attributes results in undefined behavior.

hStream.doc: The stream establishing the stream ordering promise.

cudaMallocFromPoolAsync.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMallocFromPoolAsync(void * * ptr, size_t size, cudaMemPool_t memPool, cudaStream_t stream)
cudaMallocFromPoolAsync.doc:
Allocates memory from a specified pool with stream ordered semantics.

Inserts an allocation operation into `stream`. A pointer to the allocated memory is returned immediately in \*dptr. The allocation must not be accessed until the allocation operation completes. The allocation comes from the specified memory pool.

stream.doc: The stream establishing the stream ordering semantic.

cudaMemGetDefaultMemPool.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemGetDefaultMemPool(cudaMemPool_t * memPool, struct cudaMemLocation * location, enum cudaMemAllocationType type)
cudaMemGetDefaultMemPool.doc:
Returns the default memory pool for a given location and allocation type.

The memory location can be of one of [cudaMemLocationTypeDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0ae479b8710f3c5270117ee9d8cf5868d4), [cudaMemLocationTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a1ec97ff5f3c715e4b18e39dabf9e31c5), [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNuma](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a24dc63fb938dee27b41e3842da35d2d0), or [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b). The allocation type can be one of [cudaMemAllocationTypePinned](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3a8caa8664e92a198cb429c7a5f2e49c6e) or [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f). When the allocation type is [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f), the location type can also be [cudaMemLocationTypeNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a53b6266fa56e0b7efe6a0b78ed8e8f49) to indicate no preferred location for the managed memory pool. [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f) can not be used with [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b). In all other cases, the call return [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c).

cudaMemGetMemPool.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemGetMemPool(cudaMemPool_t * memPool, struct cudaMemLocation * location, enum cudaMemAllocationType type)
cudaMemGetMemPool.doc:
Gets the current memory pool for a given memory location and allocation type.

The memory location can be of one of [cudaMemLocationTypeDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0ae479b8710f3c5270117ee9d8cf5868d4), [cudaMemLocationTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a1ec97ff5f3c715e4b18e39dabf9e31c5), [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNuma](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a24dc63fb938dee27b41e3842da35d2d0), or [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b). The allocation type can be one of [cudaMemAllocationTypePinned](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3a8caa8664e92a198cb429c7a5f2e49c6e) or [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f). When the allocation type is [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f), the location type can also be [cudaMemLocationTypeNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a53b6266fa56e0b7efe6a0b78ed8e8f49) to indicate no preferred location for the managed memory pool. [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f) can not be used with [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b). In all other cases, the call return [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c)

Returns the last pool provided to [cudaMemSetMemPool](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1gac8dd25590cfaef0a3982123c6441e616) or [cudaDeviceSetMemPool](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1ga02bb50d2e2af83e5f24d0b2ab9dadc82) for this location and allocation type or the location’s default memory pool if [cudaMemSetMemPool](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1gac8dd25590cfaef0a3982123c6441e616) or [cudaDeviceSetMemPool](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1ga02bb50d2e2af83e5f24d0b2ab9dadc82) for that allocType and location has never been called. By default the current mempool of a location is the default mempool for a device that can be obtained via cudaMemGetDefaultMemPool Otherwise the returned pool must have been set with [cudaDeviceSetMemPool](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1ga02bb50d2e2af83e5f24d0b2ab9dadc82).

cudaMemPoolCreate.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolCreate(cudaMemPool_t * memPool, const struct cudaMemPoolProps * poolProps)
cudaMemPoolCreate.doc:
Creates a memory pool.

Creates a CUDA memory pool and returns the handle in `pool`. The `poolProps` determines the properties of the pool such as the backing device and IPC capabilities.

To create a memory pool for host memory not targeting a specific NUMA node, applications must set set ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::type to [cudaMemLocationTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a1ec97ff5f3c715e4b18e39dabf9e31c5). ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::id is ignored for such pools. Pools created with the type [cudaMemLocationTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a1ec97ff5f3c715e4b18e39dabf9e31c5) are not IPC capable and [cudaMemPoolProps::handleTypes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaMemPoolProps.html#structcudamempoolprops_1a4cf896bffe71384e374c4d2decca9a53) must be 0, any other values will result in [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c). To create a memory pool targeting a specific host NUMA node, applications must set ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::type to [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNuma](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a24dc63fb938dee27b41e3842da35d2d0) and ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::id must specify the NUMA ID of the host memory node. Specifying [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNumaCurrent](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0aa3925690e32332c940cb726ef56a4258) as the ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::type will result in [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c). To create a memory pool targeting a specific device locality domain, applications must set ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::type to [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b), ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::localized.deviceId must specify the device ID, and ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation::localized.localityDomainId must specify the locality domain ID. The locality domain ID must be a valid locality domain ID for the specified device. See also [cudaDeviceGetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1ga3559b8cc346511d423b5a6def5fbd3e0) with the attribute [cudaDevAttrLocalityDomainCount](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga49e2f8c2c0bd6fe264f2fc970912e5cda53544b5a7a807fb2c96f15dda587500d). By default, the pool’s memory will be accessible from the device it is allocated on. In the case of pools created with [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNuma](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a24dc63fb938dee27b41e3842da35d2d0) or [cudaMemLocationTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a1ec97ff5f3c715e4b18e39dabf9e31c5), their default accessibility will be from the host CPU. Applications can control the maximum size of the pool by specifying a non-zero value for [cudaMemPoolProps::maxSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaMemPoolProps.html#structcudamempoolprops_1a2d90e82afb8d577a2aee847d082e145d). If set to 0, the maximum size of the pool will default to a system dependent value.

Applications that intend to use ::CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC based memory sharing must ensure: (1) `nvidia-caps-imex-channels` character device is created by the driver and is listed under /proc/devices (2) have at least one IMEX channel file accessible by the user launching the application.

When exporter and importer CUDA processes have been granted access to the same IMEX channel, they can securely share memory.

The IMEX channel security model works on a per user basis. Which means all processes under a user can share memory if the user has access to a valid IMEX channel. When multi-user isolation is desired, a separate IMEX channel is required for each user.

These channel files exist in /dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels/channel\* and can be created using standard OS native calls like mknod on Linux. For example: To create channel0 with the major number from /proc/devices users can execute the following command: `mknod /dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels/channel0 c <major number> 0`

To create a managed memory pool, applications must set [cudaMemPoolProps](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaMemPoolProps.html#structcudamempoolprops):cudaMemAllocationType to [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f). ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemAllocationHandleType must also be set to [cudaMemHandleTypeNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggaabde707dfb8a602b917e0b177f77f365afed45251c1591431e1b9da28c1a04191) since IPC is not supported. For managed memory pools, ::cudaMemPoolProps::cudaMemLocation will be treated as the preferred location for all allocations created from the pool. An application can also set [cudaMemLocationTypeNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a53b6266fa56e0b7efe6a0b78ed8e8f49) to indicate no preferred location. [cudaMemPoolProps::maxSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaMemPoolProps.html#structcudamempoolprops_1a2d90e82afb8d577a2aee847d082e145d) must be set to zero for managed memory pools. [cudaMemPoolProps::usage](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaMemPoolProps.html#structcudamempoolprops_1a377241affe79dd0a3c7b40453824bd6b) should be zero as decompress for managed memory is not supported. For managed memory pools, all devices on the system must have non-zero ::concurrentManagedAccess. If not, this call returns [cudaErrorNotSupported](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038ad846fd9f2e8ba5e2fb4f1695b7ab6164).

cudaMemPoolDestroy.doc:
Destroys the specified memory pool.

If any pointers obtained from this pool haven’t been freed or the pool has free operations that haven’t completed when [cudaMemPoolDestroy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1ga709113128c1c52c3bf170022dc7723dd) is invoked, the function will return immediately and the resources associated with the pool will be released automatically once there are no more outstanding allocations.

Destroying the current mempool of a device sets the default mempool of that device as the current mempool for that device.

cudaMemPoolExportPointer.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolExportPointer(struct cudaMemPoolPtrExportData * exportData, void * ptr)
cudaMemPoolExportPointer.doc:
Export data to share a memory pool allocation between processes.

Constructs `shareData_out` for sharing a specific allocation from an already shared memory pool. The recipient process can import the allocation with the [cudaMemPoolImportPointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1ga07d753c8bb9b8b789b975777ff83d574) api. The data is not a handle and may be shared through any IPC mechanism.

cudaMemPoolExportToShareableHandle.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolExportToShareableHandle(void * shareableHandle, cudaMemPool_t memPool, enum cudaMemAllocationHandleType handleType, unsigned int flags)
cudaMemPoolExportToShareableHandle.doc:
Exports a memory pool to the requested handle type.

Given an IPC capable mempool, create an OS handle to share the pool with another process. A recipient process can convert the shareable handle into a mempool with [cudaMemPoolImportFromShareableHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1ga29c5389e957a281969fac357fc852c8e). Individual pointers can then be shared with the [cudaMemPoolExportPointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1gab2f607ca635363ea7d1ecbf61b725168) and [cudaMemPoolImportPointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1ga07d753c8bb9b8b789b975777ff83d574) APIs. The implementation of what the shareable handle is and how it can be transferred is defined by the requested handle type.

handle_out.doc: pointer to the location in which to store the requested handle.

handleType.doc: the type of handle to create.

cudaMemPoolGetAccess.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolGetAccess(enum cudaMemAccessFlags * flags, cudaMemPool_t memPool, struct cudaMemLocation * location)
cudaMemPoolGetAccess.doc:
Returns the accessibility of a pool from a device.

Returns the accessibility of the pool’s memory from the specified location.

flags.doc: the accessibility of the pool from the specified location.

cudaMemPoolGetAttribute.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolGetAttribute(cudaMemPool_t memPool, enum cudaMemPoolAttr attr, void * value)
cudaMemPoolGetAttribute.doc:
Gets attributes of a memory pool.

Supported attributes are:

The following properties can be also be queried on imported and default pools.

pool.doc: The memory pool to get attributes of.

value.doc: Retrieved value.

cudaMemPoolImportFromShareableHandle.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolImportFromShareableHandle(cudaMemPool_t * memPool, void * shareableHandle, enum cudaMemAllocationHandleType handleType, unsigned int flags)
cudaMemPoolImportFromShareableHandle.doc:
imports a memory pool from a shared handle.

Specific allocations can be imported from the imported pool with [cudaMemPoolImportPointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1ga07d753c8bb9b8b789b975777ff83d574).

handle.doc: OS handle of the pool to open.

handleType.doc: The type of handle being imported.

cudaMemPoolImportPointer.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolImportPointer(void * * ptr, cudaMemPool_t memPool, struct cudaMemPoolPtrExportData * exportData)
cudaMemPoolImportPointer.doc:
Import a memory pool allocation from another process.

Returns in `ptr_out` a pointer to the imported memory. The imported memory must not be accessed before the allocation operation completes in the exporting process. The imported memory must be freed from all importing processes before being freed in the exporting process. The pointer may be freed with cudaFree or cudaFreeAsync. If [cudaFreeAsync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY__POOLS.html#group__cudart__memory__pools_1ga3398a689c75448c1bf99368e490ac878) is used, the free must be completed on the importing process before the free operation on the exporting process.

shareData.doc: data specifying the memory to import.

cudaMemPoolSetAccess.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolSetAccess(cudaMemPool_t memPool, const struct cudaMemAccessDesc * descList, size_t count)
cudaMemPoolSetAccess.doc: Controls visibility of pools between devices.

map.doc: Array of access descriptors. Each descriptor instructs the access to enable for a single gpu.

count.doc: Number of descriptors in the map array.

cudaMemPoolSetAttribute.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemPoolSetAttribute(cudaMemPool_t memPool, enum cudaMemPoolAttr attr, void * value)
cudaMemPoolSetAttribute.doc:
Sets attributes of a memory pool.

Supported attributes are.

value.doc: Pointer to the value to assign.

cudaMemPoolTrimTo.doc:
Tries to release memory back to the OS.

Releases memory back to the OS until the pool contains fewer than minBytesToKeep reserved bytes, or there is no more memory that the allocator can safely release. The allocator cannot release OS allocations that back outstanding asynchronous allocations. The OS allocations may happen at different granularity from the user allocations.

minBytesToKeep.doc: If the pool has less than minBytesToKeep reserved, the TrimTo operation is a no-op. Otherwise the pool will be guaranteed to have at least minBytesToKeep bytes reserved after the operation.

cudaMemSetMemPool.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaMemSetMemPool(struct cudaMemLocation * location, enum cudaMemAllocationType type, cudaMemPool_t memPool)
cudaMemSetMemPool.doc:
Sets the current memory pool for a memory location and allocation type.

The memory location can be of one of [cudaMemLocationTypeDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0ae479b8710f3c5270117ee9d8cf5868d4), [cudaMemLocationTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a1ec97ff5f3c715e4b18e39dabf9e31c5) [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNuma](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a24dc63fb938dee27b41e3842da35d2d0), or [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b). The allocation type can be one of [cudaMemAllocationTypePinned](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3a8caa8664e92a198cb429c7a5f2e49c6e) or [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f). When the allocation type is [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f), the location type can also be [cudaMemLocationTypeNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a53b6266fa56e0b7efe6a0b78ed8e8f49) to indicate no preferred location for the managed memory pool. [cudaMemAllocationTypeManaged](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga5cb1470491e08d2c67e9efd3fb5da9a3ac9f3c6dab46c6c9cf547aba7fe021c0f) can not be used with [cudaMemLocationTypeDeviceLocalityDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a88b5d659aa9d7501f0382836eebb125b). In all other cases, the call return [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c)

When a memory pool is set as the current memory pool, the location parameter should be the same as the location of the pool. If the location type or index don’t match, the call returns [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c). The type of memory pool should also match the parameter allocType. Else the call returns [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c)

.

By default, a memory location’s current memory pool is its default memory pool. If the location type is.

cudaCreateSurfaceObject.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaCreateSurfaceObject(cudaSurfaceObject_t * pSurfObject, const struct cudaResourceDesc * pResDesc)
cudaCreateSurfaceObject.doc:
Creates a surface object.

Creates a surface object and returns it in `pSurfObject`. `pResDesc` describes the data to perform surface load/stores on. [cudaResourceDesc::resType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaResourceDesc.html#structcudaresourcedesc_1aaac8b3bb1d63bd25d8e9af7ee0b9a580) must be [cudaResourceTypeArray](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga067b774c0e639817a00a972c8e2c203caa67eb0b4b477d91a86dc043ed310d030) and ::cudaResourceDesc::res::array::array must be set to a valid CUDA array handle.

Surface objects are only supported on devices of compute capability 3.0 or higher. Additionally, a surface object is an opaque value, and, as such, should only be accessed through CUDA API calls.

cudaVDPAUGetDevice.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaVDPAUGetDevice(int * device, VdpDevice vdpDevice, VdpGetProcAddress * vdpGetProcAddress)
cudaVDPAUGetDevice.doc:

Returns the CUDA device associated with a VdpDevice, if applicable.

cudaVDPAUSetVDPAUDevice.signature: __host__ cudaError_t cudaVDPAUSetVDPAUDevice(int device, VdpDevice vdpDevice, VdpGetProcAddress * vdpGetProcAddress)
cudaVDPAUSetVDPAUDevice.doc:
Sets a CUDA device to use VDPAU interoperability.

Records `vdpDevice` as the VdpDevice for VDPAU interoperability with the CUDA device `device` and sets `device` as the current device for the calling host thread.

This function will immediately initialize the primary context on `device` if needed.

If `device` has already been initialized then this call will fail with the error [cudaErrorSetOnActiveProcess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038aa906ddf08d574274bf7334adb1497550). In this case it is necessary to reset `device` using [cudaDeviceReset()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__DEVICE.html#group__cudart__device_1gaef69dd5c6d0206c2b8d099abac61f217) before VDPAU interoperability on `device` may be enabled.

device.doc: Device to use for VDPAU interoperability.

cudaDriverGetVersion.doc:
Returns the latest version of CUDA supported by the driver.

Returns in `*driverVersion` the latest version of CUDA supported by the driver. The version is returned as (1000 major + 10 minor). For example, CUDA 9.2 would be represented by 9020. If no driver is installed, then 0 is returned as the driver version.

This function automatically returns [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c) if `driverVersion` is NULL.

cudaRuntimeGetVersion.doc:
Returns the CUDA Runtime version.

Returns in `*runtimeVersion` the version number of the current CUDA Runtime instance. The version is returned as (1000 major + 10 minor). For example, CUDA 9.2 would be represented by 9020.

As of CUDA 12.0, this function no longer initializes CUDA. The purpose of this API is solely to return a compile-time constant stating the CUDA Toolkit version in the above format.

As of CUDA 13.0, on Windows, the `runtimeVersion` may not be the same as the CUDA Toolkit version the app was built with. Windows will use the CUDA Runtime packaged with the display driver, and that version will be reported.

This function automatically returns [cudaErrorInvalidValue](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga3f51e3575c2178246db0a94a430e0038a3e8aef5398ee38e28ed41e357b48917c) if the `runtimeVersion` argument is NULL.

cudaAccessPolicyWindow.doc:
Specifies an access policy for a window, a contiguous extent of memory beginning at base_ptr and ending at base_ptr + num_bytes.

Partition into many segments and assign segments such that. sum of “hit segments” / window == approx. ratio. sum of “miss segments” / window == approx 1-ratio. Segments and ratio specifications are fitted to the capabilities of the architecture. Accesses in a hit segment apply the hitProp access policy. Accesses in a miss segment apply the missProp access policy.

base_ptr.doc:
Starting address of the access policy window.

CUDA driver may align it.

hitRatio.doc: hitRatio specifies percentage of lines assigned hitProp, rest are assigned missProp.

missProp.doc:
CUaccessProperty set for miss.

Must be either NORMAL or STREAMING.

num_bytes.doc:
Size in bytes of the window policy.

CUDA driver may restrict the maximum size and alignment.

cudaArrayMemoryRequirements.doc: CUDA array and CUDA mipmapped array memory requirements.

alignment.doc: Alignment necessary for mapping the array.

cudaArraySparseProperties.doc: Sparse CUDA array and CUDA mipmapped array properties.

flags.doc: Flags will either be zero or [cudaArraySparsePropertiesSingleMipTail](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga6820071ffa1300699897eab8d319e4d9).

miptailFirstLevel.doc: First mip level at which the mip tail begins.

miptailSize.doc: Total size of the mip tail.

cudaAsyncNotificationInfo_t.doc: Information describing an async notification event.

bytesOverBudget.doc: The number of bytes that the process has allocated above its device memory budget.

info.doc:
Information about the notification.

`type` must be checked in order to interpret this field.

type.doc: The type of notification being sent.

graph.doc:
The child graph to clone into the node for node creation, or a handle to the graph owned by the node for node query.

The graph must not contain conditional nodes. Graphs containing memory allocation or memory free nodes must set the ownership to be moved to the parent.

ownership.doc: The ownership relationship of the child graph node.

handle.doc:
Conditional node handle.

Handles must be created in advance of creating the node using [cudaGraphConditionalHandleCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__GRAPH.html#group__cudart__graph_1gaf8254179427201565eacbca09a29566f).

phGraph_out.doc:
CUDA-owned array populated with conditional node child graphs during creation of the node.

Valid for the lifetime of the conditional node. The contents of the graph(s) are subject to the following constraints:

These graphs may be populated using graph node creation APIs or [cudaStreamBeginCaptureToGraph](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__STREAM.html#group__cudart__stream_1ga52d4a730019358ef25b721f959543f23). cudaGraphCondTypeIf: phGraph_out[0] is executed when the condition is non-zero. If `size` == 2, phGraph_out[1] will be executed when the condition is zero. cudaGraphCondTypeWhile: phGraph_out[0] is executed as long as the condition is non-zero. cudaGraphCondTypeSwitch: phGraph_out[n] is executed when the condition is equal to n. If the condition >= `size`, no body graph is executed.

size.doc:
Size of graph output array.

Allowed values are 1 for cudaGraphCondTypeWhile, 1 or 2 for cudaGraphCondTypeIf, or any value greater than zero for cudaGraphCondTypeSwitch.

cudaDevResource.doc:
A tagged union describing different resources identified by the type field.

This structure should not be directly modified outside of the API that created it.

type.doc: Type of resource, dictates which union field was last set.

cudaDevSmResource.doc:
Data for SM-related resources All parameters in this structure are OUTPUT only.

Do not write to any of the fields in this structure.

localityDomainId.doc:
Locality domain that the SM must be located on.

Only valid if cudaDevSmResourceConstraintTypeLocalityDomainId is set in flags.

minSmPartitionSize.doc: The minimum number of streaming multiprocessors required to partition this resource.

smCoscheduledAlignment.doc:
The number of streaming multiprocessors in this resource that are guaranteed to be co-scheduled on the same GPU processing cluster.

smCount will be a multiple of this value, unless the backfill flag is set.

smCount.doc: The amount of streaming multiprocessors available in this resource.

coscheduledSmCount.doc: The amount of co-scheduled SMs grouped together for locality purposes.

flags.doc: Combination of `cudaDevSmResourceGroup_flags` values to indicate this this group is created.

localityDomainId.doc:
Locality domain that the SM must be located on.

Only valid if cudaDevSmResourceGroupLocalityDomainId is set in flags.

preferredCoscheduledSmCount.doc: When possible, combine co-scheduled groups together into larger groups of this size.

smCount.doc: The amount of SMs available in this resource.

cudaDevWorkqueueConfigResource.doc: Data for workqueue configuration related resources.

device.doc: The device on which the workqueue resources are available.

sharingScope.doc: The sharing scope for the workqueue resources.

wqConcurrencyLimit.doc: The expected maximum number of concurrent stream-ordered workloads.

cudaDevWorkqueueResource.doc: Handle to a pre-existing workqueue related resource.

canMapHostMemory.doc: Device can map host memory with cudaHostAlloc/cudaHostGetDevicePointer.

canUseHostPointerForRegisteredMem.doc: Device can access host registered memory at the same virtual address as the CPU.

concurrentKernels.doc: Device can possibly execute multiple kernels concurrently.

concurrentManagedAccess.doc: Device can coherently access managed memory concurrently with the CPU.

cooperativeLaunch.doc: Device supports launching cooperative kernels via [cudaLaunchCooperativeKernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga504b94170f83285c71031be6d5d15f73).

deferredMappingCudaArraySupported.doc: 1 if the device supports deferred mapping CUDA arrays and CUDA mipmapped arrays.

deviceNumaConfig.doc: NUMA configuration of a device: value is of type [cudaDeviceNumaConfig](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaaf69109376a24f6493aec77f1f3e78c2) enum.

deviceNumaId.doc: NUMA node ID of the GPU memory.

directManagedMemAccessFromHost.doc: Host can directly access managed memory on the device without migration.

globalL1CacheSupported.doc: Device supports caching globals in L1.

gpuDirectRDMAFlushWritesOptions.doc: Bitmask to be interpreted according to the [cudaFlushGPUDirectRDMAWritesOptions](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga08213e5a1b0dfdeeb88ed0146ca86f63) enum.
