gpuDirectRDMAWritesOrdering.doc: See the [cudaGPUDirectRDMAWritesOrdering](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gad945c8e3f04e38760c1dac290519eb19) enum for numerical values.

gpuPciDeviceID.doc: The combined 16-bit PCI device ID and 16-bit PCI vendor ID.

gpuPciSubsystemID.doc: The combined 16-bit PCI subsystem ID and 16-bit PCI subsystem vendor ID.

hostNativeAtomicSupported.doc: Link between the device and the host supports native atomic operations.

hostNumaId.doc: NUMA ID of the host node closest to the device or -1 when system does not support NUMA.

hostNumaMultinodeIpcSupported.doc: 1 if the device supports HostNuma location IPC between nodes in a multi-node system.

hostRegisterReadOnlySupported.doc: Device supports using the [cudaHostRegister](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1gae8d5c17670f16ac4fc8fcb4181cb490c) flag cudaHostRegisterReadOnly to register memory that must be mapped as read-only to the GPU.

hostRegisterSupported.doc: Device supports host memory registration via [cudaHostRegister](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1gae8d5c17670f16ac4fc8fcb4181cb490c).

integrated.doc: Device is integrated as opposed to discrete.

isMultiGpuBoard.doc: Device is on a multi-GPU board.

l2CacheSize.doc: Size of L2 cache in bytes.

localL1CacheSupported.doc: Device supports caching locals in L1.

luid.doc:
8-byte locally unique identifier.

Value is undefined on TCC and non-Windows platforms.

luidDeviceNodeMask.doc:
LUID device node mask.

Value is undefined on TCC and non-Windows platforms.

managedMemory.doc: Device supports allocating managed memory on this system.

maxBlocksPerMultiProcessor.doc: Maximum number of resident blocks per multiprocessor.

maxGridSize.doc: Maximum size of each dimension of a grid.

maxTexture2DGather.doc: Maximum 2D texture dimensions if texture gather operations have to be performed.

maxTexture2DLinear.doc: Maximum dimensions (width, height, pitch) for 2D textures bound to pitched memory.

maxThreadsDim.doc: Maximum size of each dimension of a block.

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of threads per block.

memoryBusWidth.doc: Global memory bus width in bits.

memoryPoolsSupported.doc: 1 if the device supports using the cudaMallocAsync and cudaMemPool family of APIs, 0 otherwise.

memoryPoolSupportedHandleTypes.doc: Bitmask of handle types supported with mempool-based IPC.

memPitch.doc: Maximum pitch in bytes allowed by memory copies.

mpsEnabled.doc: Indicates if contexts created on this device will be shared via MPS.

multiGpuBoardGroupID.doc: Unique identifier for a group of devices on the same multi-GPU board.

pageableMemoryAccess.doc: Device supports coherently accessing pageable memory without calling cudaHostRegister on it.

pageableMemoryAccessUsesHostPageTables.doc: Device accesses pageable memory via the host’s page tables.

pciBusID.doc: PCI bus ID of the device.

pciDeviceID.doc: PCI device ID of the device.

pciDomainID.doc: PCI domain ID of the device.

persistingL2CacheMaxSize.doc: Device’s maximum l2 persisting lines capacity setting in bytes.

reservedSharedMemPerBlock.doc: Shared memory reserved by CUDA driver per block in bytes.

sharedMemPerBlock.doc: Shared memory available per block in bytes.

sharedMemPerBlockOptin.doc: Per device maximum shared memory per block usable by special opt in.

sharedMemPerMultiprocessor.doc: Shared memory available per multiprocessor in bytes.

sparseCudaArraySupported.doc: 1 if the device supports sparse CUDA arrays and sparse CUDA mipmapped arrays, 0 otherwise.

tccDriver.doc: 1 if device is a Tesla device using TCC driver, 0 otherwise.

texturePitchAlignment.doc: Pitch alignment requirement for texture references bound to pitched memory.

timelineSemaphoreInteropSupported.doc: External timeline semaphore interop is supported on the device.

totalConstMem.doc: Constant memory available on device in bytes.

totalGlobalMem.doc: Global memory available on device in bytes.

unifiedAddressing.doc: Device shares a unified address space with the host.

cudaEglFrame.doc:
CUDA EGLFrame Descriptor - structure defining one frame of EGL.

Each frame may contain one or more planes depending on whether the surface is Multiplanar or not. Each plane of EGLFrame is represented by [cudaEglPlaneDesc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaEglPlaneDesc.html#structcudaeglplanedesc) which is defined as.

cudaEglPlaneDesc.doc: CUDA EGL Plane Descriptor - structure defining each plane of a CUDA EGLFrame.

numChannels.doc: Number of channels for the plane.

event.doc: The event to record when the node executes.
The event to wait on from the node.

flags.doc:

offset.doc: Offset into the memory object where the buffer’s base is.

flags.doc: Flags must either be zero or [cudaExternalMemoryDedicated](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaea2031488a28bcdb7695e9bbaf25e149).

nvSciBufObject.doc:

numExtSems.doc: Number of handles and parameters supplied in extSemArray and paramsArray.

Valid if [cudaExternalSemaphoreHandleType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gab35390be1e170db8671b0abfb57ad3d9) is of type [cudaExternalSemaphoreHandleTypeNvSciSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggab35390be1e170db8671b0abfb57ad3d9a1f340d33a5242e6aeb3a6a528046f062).

flags.doc:
Only when [cudaExternalSemaphoreSignalParams](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaExternalSemaphoreSignalParams.html#structcudaexternalsemaphoresignalparams) is used to signal a [cudaExternalSemaphore_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf8bc7ab93d638c5835e5289ac7d683c4) of type [cudaExternalSemaphoreHandleTypeNvSciSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggab35390be1e170db8671b0abfb57ad3d9a1f340d33a5242e6aeb3a6a528046f062), the valid flag is [cudaExternalSemaphoreSignalSkipNvSciBufMemSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga39b71a7aa040658a7a280fcf31eb4a77): which indicates that while signaling the [cudaExternalSemaphore_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf8bc7ab93d638c5835e5289ac7d683c4), no memory synchronization operations should be performed for any external memory object imported as [cudaExternalMemoryHandleTypeNvSciBuf](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga62ab2fcc2eb066702c3694148383749ea6f8cf38ae8bb776722f29fe5f076bdcf).

For all other types of [cudaExternalSemaphore_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf8bc7ab93d638c5835e5289ac7d683c4), flags must be zero.

value.doc: Value of fence to be signaled.

numExtSems.doc: Number of handles and parameters supplied in extSemArray and paramsArray.

paramsArray.doc: Array of external semaphore wait parameters.

numExtSems.doc: Number of handles and parameters supplied in extSemArray and paramsArray.

paramsArray.doc: Array of external semaphore wait parameters.

cudaExternalSemaphoreWaitParams.doc: External semaphore wait parameters, compatible with driver type.

fence.doc:
Pointer to NvSciSyncFence.

Valid if [cudaExternalSemaphoreHandleType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gab35390be1e170db8671b0abfb57ad3d9) is of type [cudaExternalSemaphoreHandleTypeNvSciSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggab35390be1e170db8671b0abfb57ad3d9a1f340d33a5242e6aeb3a6a528046f062).

flags.doc:
Only when [cudaExternalSemaphoreSignalParams](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaExternalSemaphoreSignalParams.html#structcudaexternalsemaphoresignalparams) is used to signal a [cudaExternalSemaphore_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf8bc7ab93d638c5835e5289ac7d683c4) of type [cudaExternalSemaphoreHandleTypeNvSciSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggab35390be1e170db8671b0abfb57ad3d9a1f340d33a5242e6aeb3a6a528046f062), the valid flag is [cudaExternalSemaphoreSignalSkipNvSciBufMemSync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga39b71a7aa040658a7a280fcf31eb4a77): which indicates that while waiting for the [cudaExternalSemaphore_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf8bc7ab93d638c5835e5289ac7d683c4), no memory synchronization operations should be performed for any external memory object imported as [cudaExternalMemoryHandleTypeNvSciBuf](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga62ab2fcc2eb066702c3694148383749ea6f8cf38ae8bb776722f29fe5f076bdcf).

For all other types of [cudaExternalSemaphore_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaf8bc7ab93d638c5835e5289ac7d683c4), flags must be zero.

key.doc: Value of key to acquire the mutex with.

timeoutMs.doc: Timeout in milliseconds to wait to acquire the mutex.

value.doc: Value of fence to be waited on.

binaryVersion.doc:
The binary architecture version for which the function was compiled.

This value is the major binary version \* 10 + the minor binary version, so a binary version 1.3 function would return the value 13.

cacheModeCA.doc: The attribute to indicate whether the function has been compiled with user specified option “-Xptxas –dlcm=ca” set.

clusterDimMustBeSet.doc: If this attribute is set, the kernel must launch with a valid cluster dimension specified.

clusterSchedulingPolicyPreference.doc:
The block scheduling policy of a function.

See [cudaFuncSetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga317e77d2657abf915fd9ed03e75f3eb0).

constSizeBytes.doc: The size in bytes of user-allocated constant memory required by this function.

deviceNodeUpdateStatus.doc:
Whether the function can be updated on device.

1 means device node update is supported, 0 is unsupported or driver is too old to check the value.

localSizeBytes.doc: The size in bytes of local memory used by each thread of this function.

maxDynamicSharedSizeBytes.doc:
The maximum size in bytes of dynamic shared memory per block for this function.

Any launch must have a dynamic shared memory size smaller than this value.

This attribute is ignored if the sharedMemoryMode function or launch attribute is set.

This attribute cannot be used to access oversized shared memory. Oversized shared memory can only be accessed by setting the shared memory mode.

See [cudaFuncSetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga317e77d2657abf915fd9ed03e75f3eb0).

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc:
The maximum number of threads per block, beyond which a launch of the function would fail.

This number depends on both the function and the device on which the function is currently loaded.

nonPortableClusterSizeAllowed.doc:
Whether the function can be launched with non-portable cluster size.

1 is allowed, 0 is disallowed. A non-portable cluster size may only function on the specific SKUs the program is tested on. The launch might fail if the program is run on a different hardware platform.

CUDA API provides [cudaOccupancyMaxActiveClusters](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__OCCUPANCY.html#group__cudart__occupancy_1gad4322b730e5b2c5a9a93f0a22c93ab03) to assist with checking whether the desired size can be launched on the current device.

Portable Cluster Size

A portable cluster size is guaranteed to be functional on all compute capabilities higher than the target compute capability. The portable cluster size for sm_90 is 8 blocks per cluster. This value may increase for future compute capabilities.

The specific hardware unit may support higher cluster sizes that’s not guaranteed to be portable.

See [cudaFuncSetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga317e77d2657abf915fd9ed03e75f3eb0).

numRegs.doc: The number of registers used by each thread of this function.

preferredShmemCarveout.doc:
On devices where the L1 cache and shared memory use the same hardware resources, this sets the shared memory carveout preference, in percent of the maximum shared memory.

Refer to [cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga49e2f8c2c0bd6fe264f2fc970912e5cdac478150b5ec1689a2944aaf7e25a5685). This is only a hint, and the driver can choose a different ratio if required to execute the function.

See [cudaFuncSetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga317e77d2657abf915fd9ed03e75f3eb0).

ptxVersion.doc:
The PTX virtual architecture version for which the function was compiled.

This value is the major PTX version \* 10 + the minor PTX version, so a PTX version 1.3 function would return the value 13.

requiredClusterWidth.doc:
The required cluster width/height/depth in blocks.

The values must either all be 0 or all be positive. The validity of the cluster dimensions is otherwise checked at launch time.

If the value is set during compile time, it cannot be set at runtime. Setting it at runtime should return cudaErrorNotPermitted.

See [cudaFuncSetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga317e77d2657abf915fd9ed03e75f3eb0).

sharedMemoryMode.doc:
This controls a kernel’s use of non-portable or oversized shared memory configurations.

See [cudaFuncSetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__EXECUTION.html#group__cudart__execution_1ga317e77d2657abf915fd9ed03e75f3eb0).

sharedSizeBytes.doc:
The size in bytes of statically-allocated shared memory per block required by this function.

This does not include dynamically-allocated shared memory requested by the user at runtime.

cudaGraphEdgeData.doc:
Optional annotation for edges in a CUDA graph.

Note, all edges implicitly have annotations and default to a zero-initialized value if not specified. A zero-initialized struct indicates a standard full serialization of two nodes with memory visibility.

from_port.doc:
This indicates when the dependency is triggered from the upstream node on the edge.

The meaning is specfic to the node type. A value of 0 in all cases means full completion of the upstream node, with memory visibility to the downstream node or portion thereof (indicated by `to_port`

).

Only kernel nodes define non-zero ports. A kernel node can use the following output port types.

reserved.doc:
These bytes are unused and must be zeroed.

This ensures compatibility if additional fields are added in the future.

to_port.doc:
This indicates what portion of the downstream node is dependent on the upstream node or portion thereof (indicated by `from_port`).

The meaning is specific to the node type. A value of 0 in all cases means the entirety of the downstream node is dependent on the upstream work.

Currently no node types define non-zero ports. Accordingly, this field must be set to zero.

type.doc:
This should be populated with a value from [cudaGraphDependencyType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga27593b22c74444da259fae137e437255).

(It is typed as char due to compiler-specific layout of bitfields.) See [cudaGraphDependencyType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ga27593b22c74444da259fae137e437255).

errorFromNode.doc:
The from node of error edge when the topologies do not match.

Otherwise NULL.

errorNode.doc:
The “to node” of the error edge when the topologies do not match.

The error node when the error is associated with a specific node. NULL when the error is generic.

result.doc: Gives more specific detail when a cuda graph update fails.

errNode_out.doc: The node which caused instantiation to fail, if any.

result_out.doc:
Whether instantiation was successful.

If it failed, the reason why.

cudaGraphKernelNodeUpdate.doc: Struct to specify a single node update to pass as part of a larger array to [cudaGraphKernelNodeUpdatesApply](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__GRAPH.html#group__cudart__graph_1ga2d558cf37c9616365c67447e61ac0d6a).

field.doc:
Which type of update to apply.

Determines how updateData is interpreted.

isEnabled.doc:
Node enable/disable data.

Nonzero if the node should be enabled, 0 if it should be disabled.

node.doc: Node to update.

offset.doc: Offset into the parameter buffer at which to apply the update.

pValue.doc: Kernel parameter data to write in.

updateData.doc:
Update data to apply.

Which field is used depends on field’s value.

graph.doc: Child graph node parameters.

reserved1.doc:
Padding.

Unused bytes must be zero.

cudaGraphRecaptureCallbackData.doc: Struct of user callback data that is invoked when node parameter mismatches are detected while recapturing to an existing graph.

callbackFunc.doc: Callback function that will be invoked.

userData.doc: Generic pointer that is passed to the callback function.

fn.doc: The function to call when the node executes.

userData.doc: Argument to pass to the function.

fn.doc: The function to call when the node executes.

syncMode.doc: The synchronization mode to use for the host task.

userData.doc: Argument to pass to the function.

extra.doc: Pointer to kernel arguments in the “extra” format.

kernelParams.doc: Array of pointers to individual kernel arguments.

sharedMemBytes.doc: Dynamic shared-memory size per thread block in bytes.

ctx.doc:
Context in which to run the kernel.

If NULL will try to use the current context.

extra.doc: Pointer to kernel arguments in the “extra” format.

functionType.doc: Type of handle passed in the func/kern/cuFunc union above.

kernelParams.doc: Array of pointers to individual kernel arguments.

sharedMemBytes.doc: Dynamic shared-memory size per thread block in bytes.

dynamicSmemBytes.doc: Dynamic shared-memory size per thread block in bytes.

cudaLaunchMemSyncDomainMap.doc:
Memory Synchronization Domain map.

See [cudaLaunchMemSyncDomain](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaafb98f7ea7b0397ed6503780f3e672d5).

By default, kernels are launched in domain 0. Kernel launched with [cudaLaunchMemSyncDomainRemote](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggaafb98f7ea7b0397ed6503780f3e672d5aac477b14c4ce022e029a4c2523eaeec2) will have a different domain ID. User may also alter the domain ID with [cudaLaunchMemSyncDomainMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/structcudaLaunchMemSyncDomainMap.html#structcudalaunchmemsyncdomainmap) for a specific stream / graph node / kernel launch. See [cudaLaunchAttributeMemSyncDomainMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggafc5ed48085f05863b1aeebb14934b056afef6b4fb87bd2e289180c2ca5805094d).

Domain ID range is available through [cudaDevAttrMemSyncDomainCount](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga49e2f8c2c0bd6fe264f2fc970912e5cda82ae431cc82ee71d008b4e8e9cac06ab).

default_.doc: The default domain ID to use for designated kernels.

remote.doc: The remote domain ID to use for designated kernels.

location.doc: Location on which the request is to change it’s accessibility.

in: number of memory access descriptors.

Must not exceed the number of GPUs.

bytesize.doc: in: size in bytes of the requested allocation.

dptr.doc: out: address of the allocation returned by CUDA.

in: location where the allocation should reside (specified in ::location).

::handleTypes must be [cudaMemHandleTypeNone](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggaabde707dfb8a602b917e0b177f77f365afed45251c1591431e1b9da28c1a04191). IPC is not supported. in: array of memory access descriptors. Used to describe peer GPU access.

cudaMemLocation.doc:
Specifies a memory location.

To specify a gpu, set type = [cudaMemLocationTypeDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0ae479b8710f3c5270117ee9d8cf5868d4) and set id = the gpu’s device ordinal. To specify a cpu NUMA node, set type = [cudaMemLocationTypeHostNuma](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga2279aa08666f329f3ba4afe397fa60f0a24dc63fb938dee27b41e3842da35d2d0) and set id = host NUMA node id.

type.doc: Specifies the location type, which modifies the meaning of id.

cudaMemPoolProps.doc: Specifies the properties of allocations made from the pool.

allocType.doc:
Allocation type.

Currently must be specified as cudaMemAllocationTypePinned.

handleTypes.doc: Handle types that will be supported by allocations from the pool.

maxSize.doc:
Maximum pool size.

When set to 0, defaults to a system dependent value.

reserved.doc: reserved for future use, must be 0.

usage.doc: Bitmask indicating intended usage for the pool.

win32SecurityAttributes.doc:
Windows-specific LPSECURITYATTRIBUTES required when [cudaMemHandleTypeWin32](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggaabde707dfb8a602b917e0b177f77f365a4b0a7c146b29154b18d39c5f3052f2f8) is specified.

This security attribute defines the scope of which exported allocations may be tranferred to other processes. In all other cases, this field is required to be zero.

cudaMemPoolPtrExportData.doc: Opaque data for exporting a pool allocation.

extent.doc:
Extents of the memcpy between src and dst.

The width, height and depth components must not be 0.

flags.doc:
Additional flags for copy from src to dst.

See [cudaMemcpyFlags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gae21aa0690949b1d1e5360e4edcf75dcf).

srcAccessOrder.doc: Source access ordering to be observed for copy from src to dst.

cudaMemcpy3DOperand.doc: Struct representing an operand for copy with [cudaMemcpy3DBatchAsync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1ga9b3b66be1f930f77f717e54783573f9a).

array.doc: Struct representing an operand when cudaMemcpy3DOperand::type is [cudaMemcpyOperandTypeArray](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggada2d93832ded1a29fd7cb28a6261ee6ca468b9e5daeac88a1cddc387310cb2952).

layerHeight.doc: Height of each layer in elements.

locHint.doc:
Hint location for the operand.

Ignored when the pointers are not managed memory or memory allocated outside CUDA.

ptr.doc: Struct representing an operand when cudaMemcpy3DOperand::type is [cudaMemcpyOperandTypePointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1ggada2d93832ded1a29fd7cb28a6261ee6ca395369a66615a9cacf1a734334859a67).

rowLength.doc: Length of each row in elements.

cudaMemcpyAttributes.doc:
Attributes specific to copies within a batch.

For more details on usage see [cudaMemcpyBatchAsync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__MEMORY.html#group__cudart__memory_1ga6126baf5d881835091c59e48890d6854).

dstLocHint.doc:
Hint location for the destination operand.

Ignored when the pointers are not managed memory or memory allocated outside CUDA.

flags.doc:
Additional flags for copies with this attribute.

See [cudaMemcpyFlags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gae21aa0690949b1d1e5360e4edcf75dcf).

srcAccessOrder.doc: Source access ordering to be observed for copies with this attribute.

srcLocHint.doc:
Hint location for the source operand.

Ignored when the pointers are not managed memory or memory allocated outside CUDA.

ctx.doc:
Context in which to run the memcpy.

If NULL will try to use the current context.

elementSize.doc:
Size of each element in bytes.

Must be 1, 2, or 4.

pitch.doc:
Pitch of destination device pointer.

Unused if height is 1.

value.doc: Value to be set.

width.doc: Width of the row in elements.

If NULL will try to use the current context.

elementSize.doc:
Size of each element in bytes.

Must be 1, 2, or 4.

pitch.doc:
Pitch of destination device pointer.

cudaOffset3D.doc: Struct representing offset into a [cudaArray_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gaaf8b3ba752727d996074a71ee997ce68) in elements.

pitch.doc: Pitch of allocated memory in bytes.

xsize.doc: Logical width of allocation in elements.

ysize.doc: Logical height of allocation in elements.

[anonymous].doc: Locality domain ordinal for device allocations localized to a locality domain, or -1 when the allocation is not localized to a locality domain.

device.doc:
The device against which the memory was allocated or registered.

If the memory type is [cudaMemoryTypeDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga13de56a8fe75569530ecc3a3106e9b6da30c8466dd99563e4b1a43dd27bf7c743) then this identifies the device on which the memory referred physically resides. If the memory type is [cudaMemoryTypeHost](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-runtime-api/cuda_runtime_api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html#group__cudart__types_1gga13de56a8fe75569530ecc3a3106e9b6da9aa7478ab438d2dfb710c9100194a5be) or::cudaMemoryTypeManaged then this identifies the device which was current when the memory was allocated or registered (and if that device is deinitialized then this allocation will vanish with that device’s state).

devicePointer.doc: The address which may be dereferenced on the current device to access the memory or NULL if no such address exists.

hostPointer.doc: The address which may be dereferenced on the host to access the memory or NULL if no such address exists.

devPtr.doc: Device pointer.

height.doc: Height of the array in elements.

pitchInBytes.doc: Pitch between two rows in bytes.

width.doc: Width of the array in elements.

addressMode.doc: Texture address mode for up to 3 dimensions.

maxMipmapLevelClamp.doc: Upper end of the mipmap level range to clamp access to.

minMipmapLevelClamp.doc: Lower end of the mipmap level range to clamp access to.

mipmapLevelBias.doc: Offset applied to the supplied mipmap level.

normalizedCoords.doc: Indicates whether texture reads are normalized or not.

sRGB.doc: Perform sRGB->linear conversion during texture read.
